_comment: P0 七条单人动画,对应 art/requirements/animation_manifest.md §2。全部 In-Place(位移由控制器/Timeline 提供),mixamo 骨架,Unity 以 Humanoid 导入后自动重定向到双角色。

items.name: AN_Player_Idle
items.prompt: a person stands still in a relaxed neutral idle pose, breathing gently, slight weight shifts, subtle head movement

items.name: AN_Player_Walk
items.prompt: a person walks forward at a normal cautious pace, ordinary relaxed gait, arms swinging naturally

items.name: AN_Player_WakeUp
items.prompt: a person slumped sitting asleep slowly wakes up, lifts their head, looks around confused, then stands up

items.name: AN_Player_Swing
items.prompt: a person swings a baseball bat with both hands in a strong horizontal strike, winds up then swings hard and follows through

items.name: AN_Player_HitFall
items.prompt: a person is shot in the chest, jerks backward from the impact and collapses falling to the ground

items.name: AN_Killer_Walk
items.prompt: a tall man walks forward slowly with calm heavy menacing steps, upright posture, deliberate unhurried pace

items.name: AN_Killer_AimFire
items.prompt: a man holding a pistol low raises it with one hand, aims steadily at a target, fires one shot with slight recoil, keeps aiming
